segments.normalizedSource: ```swift // Create an attribute set to describe an item. func addSpreadsheetToIndex(_ item: MySpreadsheetType) { // Assemble the metadata for the spreadsheet file. let attributeSet = CSSearchableItemAttributeSet(contentType: UTType.spreadsheet) attributeSet.title = item.title attributeSet.contentDescription = "Spreadsheet Document" attributeSet.thumbnailData = item.thumbnailImage attributeSet.contentURL = item.fileURL // Create the searchable item. let searchableItem = CSSearchableItem(uniqueIdentifier: item.identifier, domainIdentifier: nil, attributeSet: attributeSet) // Add the item to the index. } ```
